findings.message: The page at 0x502 is cut short after 137 bytes of 557 bytes; decoders drop it with its packets.

The logical stream 0x0000C07A has no end-of-stream page: its last page at 0x502 sets the flag but is damaged, so decoders drop it, and it ends before the end of the data, so the file was probably cut short or not finished.
